com.colonies_at_war.building.walltower.d: A guard post on the wall. Its men walk the wall itself, turning at the next tower, and they see further than men on the ground. Its level is how many of them there are.
com.colonies_at_war.building.warroom.des: A table, a map, and the people who march. Hires a garrison the way the Barracks does - two at first, twelve at the top. Tower guards defend; these are the ones who leave.
com.colonies_at_war.research.combat.stan: Guards defend a town. Soldiers leave it.
com.colonies_at_war.research.combat.curt: A wall nobody stands on is a fence.
com.colonies_at_war.research.combat.dril: Room in the barracks for %1$s more.
com.colonies_at_war.research.effects.dri: The War Room keeps %1$s more soldiers
com.colonies_at_war.research.combat.stan: Men march further behind a flag they know.
com.colonies_at_war.research.combat.maso: The same stones, laid by somebody who was taught.
com.colonies_at_war.research.combat.batt: Now there is somewhere to stand and something to stand behind.
com.colonies_at_war.research.combat.watc: Two pairs of eyes on the same stretch of wall.
com.colonies_at_war.research.effects.wat: Each Wall Tower keeps %1$s more guards
com.colonies_at_war.research.combat.nigh: The hours nobody wants are the hours it matters.
com.colonies_at_war.planner.desc: Lays your colony's wall. Sneak and right-click to change what a click does.
com.colonies_at_war.planner.marked: First corner at %s, %s. Mark the other.
com.colonies_at_war.planner.laid: %s piece(s) of wall ordered; %s were already on the plan.
com.colonies_at_war.planner.full: %s piece(s) would not fit - this colony's wall is as long as it goes.
com.colonies_at_war.planner.not_yours: You may not order building work in this colony.
com.colonies_at_war.planner.mode.grow: Growing the wall, a piece at a time
com.colonies_at_war.planner.mode.slot: Opening a slot for a tower
com.colonies_at_war.planner.help.ring: Mark two corners for a closed ring.
com.colonies_at_war.planner.help.line: Mark two points for a straight run.
com.colonies_at_war.planner.help.grow: Click to lay the next piece the way you are looking. Look right to turn a corner.
com.colonies_at_war.planner.help.slot: Click a stretch of wall to clear it for a tower or a gatehouse.
com.colonies_at_war.planner.no_left_turn: The pieces are drawn clockwise: carry on %s, or look %s to turn.
com.colonies_at_war.planner.turn_needs_a: Lay a piece of wall before turning again.
com.colonies_at_war.planner.slot_made: Slot opened at %s, %s - the Builder will take that piece down, then put your tower in the hole.
com.colonies_at_war.planner.slot_reserve: Slot reserved at %s, %s - the wall will stop on both sides of it.
com.colonies_at_war.planner.slot_closed: Slot closed at %s, %s - the Builder will fill it back in with wall.
com.colonies_at_war.planner.slot_occupie: Something is standing in that slot - take it down first, then close the gap.
com.colonies_at_war.planner.slot_not_cor: Not on a corner - pick a straight stretch of the run.
com.colonies_at_war.planner.nothing_here: No wall of yours here yet - grow one first.
com.colonies_at_war.gui.walls.title: The walls
com.colonies_at_war.gui.walls.empty: No wall yet. Take a Wall Planner, mark two corners, and the Builder does the rest.
